title: Nvidia CEO Huang Says CoreWeave Improving, No Backstop Needed
key_facts: Huang said at a Bloomberg event in Stockholm: 'CoreWeave's strength is improving every day. I'm optimistic.'
He said CoreWeave's cost of capital is decreasing
CoreWeave shares fell 15% on Wednesday and dipped again Thursday morning
CoreWeave's corporate bonds continued to be sold on AI-slowdown fears
Nvidia invested $2 billion in CoreWeave stock in January and holds about 47.2 million shares, roughly 10%
CoreWeave buys Nvidia GPUs and rents compute to hyperscalers such as Meta
Selling spread to Nebius, Oracle and others
quote_evidence: "CoreWeave's strength is improving every day," Huang shared at a Bloomberg event in Stockholm. "I'm optimistic. Their cost of capital is actually decreasing."
Analyst Tal Liani: "Nvidia is basically financing all these deals with them, with other hyperscalers because they want to block off the competition."
why_it_matters_hint: AI-infrastructure confidence depends partly on what Nvidia says about its own customers.
notes: Bloomberg blocked (headline only); read Yahoo Finance's own report of the same event. The 'no backstop needed' line is from Bloomberg's headline and was not in the Yahoo text, so it is attributed to Bloomberg's headline.
